## What I built

**Scaffold**
- `pyproject.toml` — PEP 621, hatchling, `requires-python = "&gt;=3.11,&lt;3.13"`, `src/` layout, console script `dashpublish = "dashpublish.cli.main:app"`. All runtime deps declared (typer, pydantic&gt;=2, pydantic-settings, sqlalchemy&gt;=2, alembic, fastapi, uvicorn[standard], httpx, google-genai, google-api-python-client, google-auth-oauthlib, google-auth-httplib2). Dev extra: pytest, ruff. `[tool.ruff]` line-length 100, `[tool.pytest.ini_options]` testpaths=["tests"].
- `.gitignore`, `.env.example`, `dashpublish.example.toml` (loads cleanly into the config schema — asserted in a test), `README.md`.
- Placeholder packages with `__init__.py` for all reserved dirs; `web/.gitkeep`. `cli/main.py` is a minimal Typer app with a `--version` callback (Package G replaces it). **No non-`__init__` files created in ingest/sentry/compile/metadata/youtube/watch/api.**

**config / paths / logging**
- `config.py`: nested pydantic models (general/embeddings/llm/scan/compile/youtube) loaded from TOML at `DASHPUBLISH_CONFIG` (default `./dashpublish.toml`, falls back to defaults if missing). Secrets env-only (`gemini_api_key`, `dashscope_api_key`, `youtube_client_secrets`), `fake_mode` from `DASHPUBLISH_FAKE`. Cached `load_config()` + `reset_config()`.
- `paths.py`: `resolve_paths(config) -&gt; Paths` dataclass (data_dir, db_path=`data/db.sqlite`, clips_dir, compilations_dir, thumbs_dir, tokens_dir, music_dir) — creates dirs on build.
- `logging.py`: idempotent `setup_logging(verbose)` + `get_logger(name)`.

**db/ (the shared contract)**
- `models.py`: 9 tables (videos, categories, clips, scans, compilations, compilation_clips, publish_records, jobs, settings), SQLAlchemy 2.0 `Mapped`/`mapped_column`, UTC `created_at` defaults, JSON columns, enums-as-String. Unique constraints on `clips.dedupe_key` (`uq_clips_dedupe_key`) and `videos.path` (`uq_videos_path`).
- `engine.py`: `get_engine(db_path)` (cached, `check_same_thread=False`, WAL + `foreign_keys=ON` pragmas, `:memory:` supported), `get_sessionmaker`, `session_scope(db_path)` contextmanager, `create_all_for_tests(engine)`, `upgrade_db(db_path)` (runs Alembic to head programmatically).
- `schemas.py`: DTOs — VideoOut, CategoryOut/CategoryIn, ClipOut/ClipPatch, ScanOut, CompilationOut/CompilationCreate/CompilationClipOut, PublishRecordOut, JobOut, SettingOut, and `SearchMatch(score, source_file, start_s, end_s, saved_clip_path)`.
- `repo.py`: all helpers below.

**jobs/queue.py**: `enqueue(session, type, payload) -&gt; JobOut`, `claim_next(session) -&gt; Job|None` (oldest queued→running), `update_progress(session, job_id, progress, message=None)`, `finish(session, job_id, error=None)`, plus `get_job`/`list_jobs`. `JOB_TYPES = ["index","scan","compile","upload","publish"]`.

**llm/base.py**: `LLMProvider` Protocol (`chat_json(system,user,schema)-&gt;dict`, `complete(prompt)-&gt;str`) + `FakeProvider(responses=[...], text=None)` (pops responses in order, repeats last; records `.calls`).

**testing.py**: re-exports `FakeProvider`; `make_test_session(db_path=":memory:")`, factories `make_video/make_category/make_clip/make_compilation`.

**Alembic**: `alembic.ini` + `migrations/` with initial autogenerated revision `ca0de44010d6` covering all 9 tables and both unique constraints.

## Contract surface B–G must know

**Getting a session**: `from dashpublish.db.engine import session_scope; with session_scope(db_path) as session: ...` (commits on success, rolls back on error). `db_path` comes from `resolve_paths(load_config()).db_path`. Repo functions take `session` first, `flush` (not commit), and return ORM objects — the caller owns the transaction.

**repo.py signatures** (all take `session: Session` first):
- Videos: `upsert_video(session, path, **fields)`, `list_videos`, `get_unindexed_videos`, `mark_indexed(session, video_id, indexed_at=None)`
- Categories: `list_categories(session, enabled_only=False)`, `get_category`, `get_category_by_name`, `create_category(session, CategoryIn)`, `update_category(session, id, **fields)`, `delete_category`, `seed_default_categories(session)` (8 builtins: overtaking, high-speed, cut-off, near-miss, tailgating, red-light, crash, funny; each threshold 0.5, save_top 3, enabled, is_builtin — idempotent by name)
- Clips: `make_dedupe_key(video_id, start_s, window)` → `f"{video_id}:{int(start_s//window)}"`; `upsert_clip_deduped(session, *, video_id, score, start_s, end_s, window, category_id=None, category_name=None, clip_path=None, scan_id=None)` (keyword-only; higher score wins, loser's category name merged into winner `user_tags["also"]`); `list_clips(session, *, category=None, starred=None, hidden=None, video_id=None, min_score=None, sort="score"|"recent"|"start")`; `get_clip`; `patch_clip(session, id, ClipPatch)`
- Scans: `create_scan(session, params=None)`, `finish_scan(session, id, *, status="done", clips_found=None, error=None)`, `list_scans`
- Compilations: `create_compilation(session, *, profile="short", title=None, music_path=None, status="draft")`, `update_compilation(session, id, **fields)`, `list_compilations`, `get_compilation`, `add_compilation_clips(session, id, items=[{clip_id, order_index?, trim_start?, trim_end?}])` (auto order_index), `list_compilation_clips`
- Publish: `create_publish_record(session, *, compilation_id, privacy_status="private", title=None, description=None, tags_json=None, youtube_video_id=None)`, `update_publish_record`, `list_publish_records(session, compilation_id=None)`
- Settings: `get_setting(session, key, default=None)`, `set_setting(session, key, value)`, `list_settings`

**Alembic wiring**: `migrations/env.py` imports `Base.metadata` and resolves the URL from `DASHPUBLISH_DB_URL` (full URL) → `DASHPUBLISH_DB` (sqlite file path) → `alembic.ini` default. So `DASHPUBLISH_DB=./x.sqlite alembic upgrade head` works, and `upgrade_db(db_path)` does it programmatically (sets `sqlalchemy.url` directly). `render_as_batch=True` for SQLite ALTERs.

**Env note**: `python -m uv pip install` targets the ambient Python; installs must be scoped to the venv via `--python .venv/Scripts/python.exe` (or `python -m uv sync`, which correctly uses `.venv`).

## Notes for the FastAPI integrator

- **Dist path**: `frontend/dist`. Assets referenced as absolute `/assets/*`; favicon at `/favicon.svg`. Serve `dist/index.html` as fallback for every non-`/api` GET (routes used: `/`, `/build`, `/review/:id`, `/settings`, `/status`).
- **Endpoints called** — exactly per contract, with these specifics to be aware of:
  - `GET /api/clips` is always called with `hidden=false` on Library (booleans serialized as `true`/`false` strings; FastAPI parses these fine), plus optional `starred`, `min_score`, `sort`. **Category multi-select is filtered client-side** since the contract only exposes a single `category` param — the `category` query param is currently never sent.
  - `PATCH /api/clips/{id}` sends `user_tags` as an object with the full replacement map (`{tag: true}` entries); the UI treats tags as key-only chips.
  - `POST /api/compilations` sends either `clip_ids` or `from_selection`, never both; `music_path` only when non-empty.
  - `PATCH /api/compilations/{id}` sends `{title?, edl}` where `edl` preserves whatever extra top-level keys the LLM produced and replaces `segments`; each segment keeps unknown fields and gets `order` (0-based), `trim_start`, `trim_end` updated. Segment shape assumed: `{clip_id, order?, trim_start?, trim_end?, transition?, rationale?}` — extra fields pass through.
  - `PUT /api/settings` sends only the 5 documented keys; `youtube_authenticated` is read but never written.
  - `DELETE /api/categories/{id}` — UI expects 2xx (204 handled); delete button is disabled for `is_builtin` categories.
  - `GET /api/clips/{id}/stream` and `/api/compilations/{id}/stream` are used directly as `&lt;video src&gt;` (Range required); `/thumb` as `&lt;img src&gt;` with graceful fallback on error.
  - Polling: jobs list every 2s while any job is queued/running, single job every 1.5s, compilation every 1.5s while status is `planning`/`rendering` — backend should tolerate this rate.
- **No deviations** from the contract other than the client-side category filtering noted above.</result>

### Contract deviations
1. **`size_bytes` is NOT stored on Video** — Package A's `Video` model has no `size_bytes` column (the task brief listed it as an upsert field, but the model omits it and `upsert_video` would raise). It's carried on `DiscoveredVideo` and folded into `content_hash` (sha256 of first 1 MiB + file size). If a column is added later, `register_footage` has a NOTE comment where to wire it.
2. **Scan status `"partial"`** is written to `scans.status` on per-category errors, as specced — but note `ScanStatus` Literal in `db/schemas.py` is `"running"|"done"|"error"`. `ScanOut` validation of a partial scan would fail; Package E should either extend that Literal or map. (DB column is a plain String, so persistence is fine.)
3. **ffprobe is NOT installed on this dev machine** (contrary to the brief) — `probe_duration` returns `None` when `shutil.which("ffprobe")` fails, so `duration_s` stays NULL here; works automatically once ffprobe is present (e.g., in Docker).
4. `ts_to_seconds` returns `float | None` (None for unparseable input) rather than raising — callers skip bad entries.

### Key decisions
- **Candidates stash:** `POST /compilations` writes `edl_json = {"_candidates": {clip_ids, from_selection}}` (no dedicated column). The plan job reads it, then overwrites `edl_json` with `edl.model_dump()`. `CompilationApiOut.edl` is exposed only when the JSON contains `segments`, so the stub stays hidden and the SPA's "a plan exists" check (`edl != null`) works. `duration_s` is computed from EDL segment lengths (no column exists).
- **Job types stay within the `JobType` Literal.** Since I could only make the ScanStatus edit to schemas.py (not extend `JobType`), plan/render ride on **type `compile` with `payload.action = "plan"|"render"`**; `tasks.run_job` sub-dispatches on that action. `queue.enqueue` validates type against the Literal, so `"plan"`/`"render"` would have raised. Frontend only reads job status/progress/error, and shows `compile` as the type label — fine.
- **EDL normalization on PATCH:** each segment is canonicalized — prefer `trim_start`/`trim_end`, write `trim_start_s`/`trim_end_s`, drop the aliases; `order` re-numbered; rebuilt into an `EDL`, run through `validate_and_fix` against the compilation's clips, persisted, and `compilation_clips` rows resynced.
- **JobApiOut/ScanApiOut/PublishApiOut mapping:** job `error→failed`, `created_at→started_at`, `updated_at→finished_at` (when terminal); scan `created_at→started_at`; publish `tags_json→tags`.
- **`youtube_authenticated`** in `/settings` reflects real OAuth token presence via `is_authenticated(tokens_dir)`, independent of the fake-mode upload seam — so it reads `false` in a fresh env (matching the frontend/test expectation) while fake uploads still succeed.

### effective_config overlay semantics
Overlays five settings-table keys onto `load_config()`: `footage_dir→general.footage_dir`, `embeddings_backend→embeddings.backend`, `llm_provider→llm.provider`, `llm_model→llm.model`, `ollama_url→llm.ollama_url`. Secrets and `fake_mode` are preserved from the base config. Used in every task and in `/settings`.

### Worker lifecycle
`Worker(db_path, poll_interval=1.0)` runs a daemon thread: `claim_next → run_job → repeat`, `stop()` is event-based with join timeout; `start_worker(db_path)` helper. FastAPI lifespan starts one on startup **unless `DASHPUBLISH_NO_WORKER=1`**. `tasks.run_job(job_id, db_path)` opens its own sessions, reports progress via `queue.update_progress`, and always calls `queue.finish(..., error=str(exc))` on exception — a task never crashes the worker. `tasks.run_pending_jobs(db_path)` synchronously drains the queue (tests/CLI).

## Command inventory

| Command | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `dashpublish init [--youtube]` | Writes `dashpublish.toml` (from `./dashpublish.example.toml` if present, else an embedded fallback template — needed because Docker doesn't ship the example file), runs `upgrade_db` + seeds categories, warns (not fails) if `sentrysearch` is missing from PATH, optionally runs the YouTube OAuth browser flow. |
| `dashpublish index [PATH]` | `register_footage` + `ensure_indexed`, prints new/seen/total + indexed count. |
| `dashpublish scan [--category]... [--dry-run]` | Resolves category names (exit 1 if unknown), `ensure_indexed` + `run_scan`; `--dry-run` builds a throwaway sqlite (`create_all_for_tests` on a random tmp-dir engine) with a `FakeSentryClient`, so the real DB is never touched; exit 2 on partial scan errors. |
| `dashpublish clips list/star` | Table or `--json` listing; `star ID [--unstar]`. |
| `dashpublish compile` | Creates the compilation row + candidate stash, then **enqueues the same `compile` jobs the API uses** (`action=plan`/`render`) via `run_pending_jobs` rather than reimplementing planning/rendering. `--plan-only` stops after planning and prints the EDL JSON. |
| `dashpublish publish upload/go` | Generates missing title/description/tags from the stored EDL via `generate_metadata` before uploading; `go` flips privacy to public. |
| `dashpublish jobs [--watch]` | Lists jobs; `--watch` polls every 2s until nothing is `queued`/`running`. |
| `dashpublish serve [--host/--port]` | `uvicorn.run("dashpublish.api.app:app", ...)`. |
| `dashpublish watch [--interval]` | Runs the watch daemon (below). |

**Notable fix:** `jobs/tasks.py` (frozen) has an edge case where `_task_plan`'s `get_provider(cfg)` call, and `_task_render`'s "no EDL" check, raise *before* their own try/except sets the compilation's `status="failed"` — the job row does get `status="error"`, but the compilation is left stuck at `planning`/`rendering`. `compile_cmd.py` guards against this by checking the enqueued job's own status in addition to the compilation's, so the CLI never reports success for a job that actually errored.

## Watch daemon semantics (`src/dashpublish/watch/daemon.py`)

`watch_loop(cfg, db_path, *, interval_s=60, once=False, enqueue_only=None, stop_event=None)`. Each tick: `register_footage`; if `new &gt; 0`, sleeps `SETTLE_S=30s` (mockable via `daemon.time.sleep`) then re-registers once (a "settle" pass for still-uploading files), then enqueues `index` + `scan` jobs. `enqueue_only` defaults to `DASHPUBLISH_NO_WORKER=1` (matching the compose `watch` service, which shares its DB with `web`'s worker); otherwise it drains via `run_pending_jobs`. `KeyboardInterrupt` is caught and logged, not propagated.

## Docker design

- Multi-stage: `node:20-alpine` builds the SPA, then `python:3.12-slim` (+ffmpeg, git) installs the package.
- **SPA into the wheel**: the built `frontend/dist` is `COPY`'d into `src/dashpublish/web` *before* `uv pip install --system .`. I verified empirically (`uv build --wheel`, then inspected the zip) that hatchling's default wheel build for this repo includes any non-gitignored file under `src/dashpublish/` regardless of git-tracked status — so this placement is safe, not merely assumed.
- `sentrysearch` install is best-effort (`|| echo ...`) so a network hiccup during build never breaks the image.
- `docker-compose.yml` uses a YAML anchor (`x-app`) for the shared `web`/`watch` service config; validated with `docker compose config` (temporarily supplying a `.env` copied from `.env.example`, then removed — no real secrets touched).

## What was built (9 commits on `master`)

- **Pipeline**: `dashpublish index` registers footage (auto-detects Tesla multi-cam event folders, prefers the front camera, plus generic MP4/MOV trees) and feeds it to sentrysearch; `dashpublish scan` runs 8 configurable category queries (overtaking, high-speed, cut-off, near-miss, tailgating, red-light, crash, funny) and stores deduped clips in SQLite.
- **Compilations**: an LLM (Gemini or Ollama, configurable) plans an edit decision list from clip metadata; ffmpeg renders it — short-form (1080×1920 vertical, ≤60s) or long-form (16:9), original audio with optional ducked background music.
- **Publishing**: AI-generated title/description/tags, resumable YouTube upload as Private, then review-and-publish — from the web UI or `dashpublish publish upload` / `publish go`.
- **Web UI**: React SPA served by FastAPI — clip library with playback/starring/tagging, compilation builder with drag-to-reorder EDL editor, review/publish screen, settings, and live job status.
- **Ops**: `dashpublish watch` daemon for auto-processing new uploads, Dockerfile + compose (`web` + `watch` services, ffmpeg and sentrysearch baked in), and a README covering setup including the Google/YouTube key walkthroughs.

## How it was verified

Beyond the 174-test suite, I drove a real end-to-end run: generated actual video footage with ffmpeg, ingested it, ran a scan (cross-category dedupe confirmed), rendered a real 23s vertical short (verified 1080×1920 via ffprobe), generated metadata, and completed the fake-mode upload→publish flow. I also probed the live server (SPA routing, Range streaming with 206/416, real JPEG thumbnails) and smoke-tested the built Docker image. Two integration bugs found and fixed along the way: compilations could get stuck in `planning`/`rendering` when a job failed early, and compose hard-required a `.env` file.

## What's left for you (needs your accounts — can't be done for you)

1. `python -m uv run dashpublish init` then set `footage_dir` in `dashpublish.toml`.
2. Put `GEMINI_API_KEY` in `.env` (free key from aistudio.google.com) and install sentrysearch locally if not using Docker.
3. For YouTube: create OAuth desktop credentials in Google Cloud Console (README has steps) and run `dashpublish init --youtube`.
4. Or skip local setup entirely: `docker compose up --build`. You can also demo everything with no keys via `DASHPUBLISH_FAKE=1`.

**Claude:** Here's where things stand while the local-backend image builds:

**Fixed and committed (3 commits):**
1. **The crash you reported** — migrations now ship inside the package, so `upgrade_db` works from the installed wheel in Docker. Also made alembic the single schema-init path and taught it to recover from the `web`/`watch` concurrent-init race on the shared volume (which was the *second* crash waiting behind the first one).
2. **The "cannot find files" issue** — two config problems: your `dashpublish.toml` had `footage_dir = "./footage"` (resolves to `/app/footage` inside the container; compose mounts footage at `/data/footage` — now fixed in your config), and your `.env` had `DASHPUBLISH_FAKE=1`, which made everything a silent no-op demo (now set to 0). I also pointed `ollama_url` at `host.docker.internal` since `localhost` inside a container is the container itself.
3. **A real product bug this uncovered** — sentrysearch exits 0 even when *every* chunk fails to embed (they go to its internal DLQ), so dashpublish reported clean indexes that stored nothing. The client now inspects the output and raises with the actual cause. In your case that cause was: the slim image has plain sentrysearch, but your config uses `backend = "local"`, which needs torch (`No module named 'torch'`).

**Verified working in Docker already:** watch daemon starts clean, sees your 3 videos, enqueues jobs after the settle pass, and the web worker really invokes sentrysearch (indexed your files and ran all 8 category searches).

**In progress:** rebuilding the image with `--build-arg SENTRYSEARCH_EXTRAS=local`. Heads-up on what that path costs: first index will download the qwen8b model (~16 GB) into the `sentry-data` volume, and CPU-only embedding in Docker is slow (upstream quotes 2–5s/chunk on an A100 — expect much worse on CPU). If that turns out too painful, the one-line alternative is `backend = "gemini"` in `dashpublish.toml` plus a free `GEMINI_API_KEY` in `.env` (~$2.84/hour of footage). I'll restart the stack when the build lands.
